"Automatic" follows the data type — a Date/Time/DateTime/DateTimeTz field is a time dimension, anything else is not. Pick "No" to keep a temporal column (e.g. an audit timestamp) off the time axis. Every other field is simply a field, usable for grouping/filtering.
